name: Prefixes and derivation: ri-, dis-, in-, pre-, sovra-, contro-, anti-; -ino, -one, -accio
subtitle: A prefix changes a word's meaning. Ri- repeats: rifare. In- and dis- deny: infelice, disonesto. Pre- comes before: prevedere. Sotto- and sovra- go under or over: sottovalutare, sovraccarico. Contro- and anti- go against: controproposta, antifurto. Endings such as -ino, -one and -accio add size or attitude: tavolino, portone, tempaccio. Learn the pattern and you guess the meaning of new words.

concept.exampleHtml: rifare · infelice · disonesto · prevedere · controproposta · tavolino

qa.html: Ri- means “again” or “back”: rifare, rileggere, riaprire, ritornare, rinnovare. It is the most productive prefix: you can add it to almost any verb that can be repeated. Devo rileggere il contratto.

Negative prefixes. In- (infelice, inutile) changes before some letters: im- before b, m, p (impossibile, imbevibile), il- before l (illegale), ir- before r (irregolare). Dis- and s- deny or undo: disonesto, disoccupato, disattivare, sfortunato, scontento, slegare. No rule says which one a word takes: learn the pair.

Time, place and degree: pre- before (prevedere, preavviso), post- after, sotto- under (sottovalutare, sottoscrivere), sovra- / sopra- over (sovraccarico, sopravvalutare), inter- between, extra- outside (extracomunitario), co- / con- together (coinquilino, collaborare).
Against: contro- (controproposta, controindicazione, controfirma) and anti- (antifurto, anticoncezionale, antinebbia). Contro- often means “in reply” (a counter-offer), anti- “protecting against”.

Alterations change size or attitude: -ino, -etto, -ello small or nice (tavolino, libretto, ragazzino), -one big (librone, portone), -accio bad (tempaccio, parolaccia, ragazzaccio). Many are now words of their own: il portone is the main door of a building, il bottone is a button. -one often makes a feminine word masculine: la porta → il portone, la palla → il pallone.

Spelling: prefix and base form one word, no hyphen (preavviso, controproposta), and the consonant sometimes doubles (sopra + valutare → sopravvalutare; sovra + carico → sovraccarico). Check a dictionary: alterations cannot be added to every word, and a learner who invents un'ufficiona sounds odd.

boxes.badge: Careful: before b, m, p, l, r
items: in- becomes im- before b, m, p: impossibile.
in- becomes il- before l and ir- before r: illegale, irregolare.
sopra- and sovra- can double the next consonant: sopravvalutare.

Il portone del palazzo è chiuso.
